title: Gilmore Girls Quiz: How Well Do You Know Lorelai Gilmore?
content:
About This Quiz
Growing up, every Gilmore Girls fan dreamed of having Lorelai as their mom at least once. She was fun, relatable and always knew how to make light of a situation. Lorelai was bursting with personality and was known for her quick wit and hilarious banter, which makes her one of the most beloved television moms of all time. While she wasn't always the perfect parent, the one thing about Lorelai that was undeniable was her unconditional love for her daughter Rory.
